correctness.rationale: Proof defines every vertex, move, surplus and exceptional parity penalty. Three edge-type comparisons establish monotonicity; explicit finite move sequences establish local elimination with the exact signed hub gain; the reserve ordering proves hub reachability, and an exceptional q=3 predecessor argument proves free-destination necessity. The per-blade sharp inequality gives the universal upper threshold and a nonstackable size-(4k-1) configuration proves sharpness. Independent exhaustive backward search checked 2,094,681 configurations through k=4 and 3,721 local pairs; finite data are corroborative only.

value.rationale: Exact newly introduced pebbling parameter for all friendship graphs, plus a constructive configuration-wise criterion at a prescribed hub and unrestricted destination. The new 4k threshold exceeds the known independence-number lower bound 3k+1 for every k>=2 and explains its gap through exceptional local parity penalties. This is a natural triangle-cactus family, not an arbitrary parameter slice; the obstruction works at every k.
